Question Choices: What square matrix I satisfies AI=A for every matrix A with the compatible number of columns?
Hints: It plays the role of the number 1.|Multiplication by it changes nothing.
Solution: The identity has diagonal ones and other entries zero; the zero matrix has all entries zero. For an m by n matrix A, I_m A=A=A I_n. A compatible product with a zero matrix is a zero matrix of the product's dimensions. I, the identity matrix.
